visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a title screen featuring large orange text over a blurry background of a Japanese drugstore shelf. Hands are shown rubbing together in the foreground. (2) The first product, TBC Hand Serum, is introduced. The camera shows the product in its plastic packaging on a shelf, followed by a close-up of a milky white liquid being squeezed from a small bottle onto the back of a woman's hand. (3) The second product, Hands Å P.P. Professional Hand Cream, is shown. The narrator picks up the blue and white box from a crowded shelf. A dollop of white cream is applied to the hand, and the person rubs it in, demonstrating its texture against the skin in a brightly lit indoor environment. (4) The third product, TENIHANA Hand Cream, is highlighted. The beige tube is shown on a display stand, followed by a close-up of a yellowish cream being squeezed out. The hands are shown massaging the cream into the skin, which appears smooth and hydrated. (5) The fourth product, SERUMYU Hand Gel, is featured. The yellow bottle is seen on a shelf. A clear, slightly yellowish gel is applied to the hand. The camera focuses on the lightweight consistency as it is spread across the skin. (6) The video concludes with a pink screen asking viewers for their favorites, followed by a brand logo with social media icons and the website 'japanuts.com'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with high-energy, upbeat electronic pop music featuring bright synthesizer chords and a driving drum machine rhythm. A female narrator speaks with an enthusiastic and welcoming tone in Traditional Chinese. (2) As the first product is shown, a subtle high-pitched 'ding' sound effect highlights the transition. The music continues at a steady pace of approximately 135 BPM, providing a cheerful background bed while the narrator details the TBC serum's properties. (3) The second phase introduces the Hands Å P.P. cream. Another 'pop' sound effect occurs as the text overlay changes. The narrator's pitch remains high and engaging, synchronized with the rhythmic pulse of the BGM. (4) Phase four transitions to the TENIHANA cream. The acoustic environment is very clean, with the vocal track positioned prominently over the music. The narrator emphasizes the 'fast absorption' benefit through an upward inflection. (5) The final product, SERUMYU gel, is introduced with a percussive accent. The music maintains its energetic major-key feel throughout. (6) The video ends with the BGM fading out quickly after the narrator delivers a call to action, leaving a brief moment of silence at the logo reveal.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Selection -> Detailed Features -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide shopping recommendations for hand creams found in Japanese drugstores for the year 2025. It targets viewers interested in skincare by showcasing four different products with varying textures (serum, cream, gel) and functions (waterproofing, deep penetration), encouraging audience engagement at the end.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of products with their brand names, specific pricing in Yen, and a detailed breakdown of their unique selling points.
